# lib/tick module

1 ms timebase for 8-bit PICs. This page is the reference for the `lib/tick` HAL module, for firmware authors choosing and wiring it in.

## Use it

The manifest lists one example program per family, plus peer programs for extra transports where the driver has them. Build one with the repository build driver (--example names a peer), or read it as the working starting point for your own firmware.

## API

The API is documented next to the code, in the [`lib/tick` directory](https://github.com/apojomovsky/epic-hal/tree/master/lib/tick). This page does not restate it. The manifest carries no function list, so no API table is generated here yet.

## Limits

- Not built for PIC18F2455, PIC18F2550. Reason: RAM: does not fit on this smaller part.
- Not built for PIC16F870, PIC16F871, PIC16F872. Reason: RAM: one byte of HAL state does not fit.
- Not built for PIC16F627, PIC16F627A, PIC16LF627A. Reason: flash: tick example exceeds the 1K-word part.
